title: Home Reception
description: The space follows a Modern Minimalist aesthetic with strong Biophilic and Organic Contemporary influences. It emphasizes Quiet Luxury through a monochromatic, earth-toned palette and a sophisticated play on textures rather than bold colors.

title: Modern Bedroom
description: A modern bedroom designed with a harmonious blend of natural materials and refined minimalism. The illuminated arched stone feature wall creates a striking focal point, adding depth and character to the space. Soft earthy tones, concealed ambient lighting, and carefully selected textures establish a warm and relaxing atmosphere. Clean lines and elegant furnishings enhance the sense of understated luxury and everyday comfort.

title: Wabi-Sabi Bedroom
description: This bedroom is a tranquil retreat that celebrates the beauty of imperfection, simplicity, and the passage of time. It's a space that promotes relaxation and mindfulness, allowing you to appreciate the inherent beauty in the everyday.

title: Modern IT Office
description: Contemporary luxury style with Japandi influence. Natural limestone walls, trazzo flooring, sculpted solid-stone feature desk, matte metal curved backdrop, warm neutral fabric seating, black metal accents. Soft indirect lighting creating gentle shadow gradients. High-end architectural visualization, calm atmosphere, refined material palette.

title: Harmony Living Room
description: A contemporary living space featuring clean lines, comfortable seating, and natural materials that combine functionality with sophisticated elegance.

title: Hotel Reception
description: Designed to create a memorable first impression, this hotel reception combines modern elegance, premium materials, and sophisticated lighting to provide a welcoming and luxurious guest experience.

title: Bliss Clinic
description: A modern clinic designed to provide a comfortable and welcoming environment, combining functionality, cleanliness, and contemporary aesthetics to enhance the patient experience.

title: Serenity Bedrooom
description: A modern minimalist bedroom designed with soft neutral tones, warm wood textures, and elegant lighting to create a calm and relaxing atmosphere.

title: Modern Living Room
description: A contemporary living room designed with clean lines, neutral tones, and carefully selected materials to create a comfortable, elegant, and inviting atmosphere.

title: Essence Bedroom
description: A luxurious modern bedroom that blends textured surfaces, soft furnishings, and ambient lighting to deliver a refined and cozy experience.

title: Makan Cafe
description: A space reflecting the harmony of nature and organic design, where warm concrete textures meet natural rattan fixtures and stunning river views. This design bridges the gap between rustic tranquility and modern sophistication, crafting an exceptional experience of comfort and serenity in the heart of the city.

title: Master Bedroom
description: A contemporary minimalist master bedroom that blends simplicity with elegance through a refined palette of soft whites, warm neutrals, and dark wood accents. Featuring textured walls, concealed ambient lighting, and low-profile furniture, the space creates a calm and sophisticated atmosphere. Natural materials and subtle decorative elements enhance the sense of warmth and tranquility, making it an ideal retreat for relaxation and comfort.

title: Modern Home Reception
description: This reception space embodies the essence of quiet luxury with a refined modern aesthetic. The design features clean, flowing lines and a plush modern sofa that adds a touch of softness, perfectly harmonizing with a sophisticated neutral color palette. The textured feature wall and unique, artistic pendant lighting elevate the space, creating a balanced reception environment that blends residential warmth with professional elegance.

title: Serenity Master Bedroom
description: A master bedroom designed around tranquility and organic textures, beautifully merging Japandi minimalism with Bohemian warmth. The focal point is a striking intricate 3D mandala relief wall carving, framed by rich vertical wood paneling that adds vertical depth. The layout centers on a plush, low-profile upholstered platform bed in an earthy monochromatic tone. Handcrafted macramé wall decor, a minimalist circular wall sconce, and curated indoor greenery soften the clean architectural lines, resulting in a refined yet cozy residential retreat.

title: Wabi-Sabi Bathroom
description: A master bathroom celebrating raw materials and geometric simplicity. The vanity pairs a carved stone basin with a live-edge wooden slab, complemented by earthy micro-cement walls and a sleek floating toilet.

title: Luxury Master Bedroom
description: A master bedroom design that embodies modern luxury through a deep monochromatic palette and clean geometric lines. The focal point is a sleek dark wood paneled accent wall highlighted by warm linear lighting for added depth. A stylish slatted wooden screen elegantly separates the sleeping area from the integrated walk-in wardrobe, while a low-profile upholstered bed anchors the space with a sense of calm and comfort.

title: Luxury Bathroom
description: A bathroom focusing on soft architectural curves and raw, tactile surfaces. The space features a custom floating vanity hosting a sculptural stone vessel sink.

title: Vila Reception
description: A modern open-plan interior design emphasizing seamless connectivity between the living lounge and the dining area. The space relies on a warm, neutral color palette combining rich wood paneling with soft, light-toned surfaces to evoke a cozy yet luxurious hospitality feel. Architectural highlights like the floating illuminated staircase and curated indoor greenery are strategically placed to balance visual depth with a serene, upscale ambiance.

title: New Classic Vila
description: A residential villa exterior design that blends classic architectural symmetry with modern clean lines. The facade features large glass windows that enhance natural light and visual openness. The property is surrounded by minimalist landscaping, incorporating soft greenery and traditional water features to create a welcoming and balanced environment.

title: Modern Raw Stone Bedroom
description: A master bedroom design centered on contemporary luxury and bold, tactile elements. The space features a dramatic dark raw stone accent wall, highlighted by strategic hidden lighting that accentuates its natural rugged texture. A low-profile upholstered bed and a neutral color palette complete the look, creating a balanced and deeply serene environment.
